name: Maven Wireless Sweden AB (Publ)
summary: Maven Wireless Sweden AB (Publ) specializes in providing robust wireless solutions for various indoor and subterranean environments. Their comprehensive product portfolio addresses coverage needs in places like tunnels, trains, subways, arenas, stadiums, and buildings. The company's offerings include advanced head end units such as the compact Orion, a 3HU rack-mounted design that can be configured with up to eight RF band modules. Another key unit is the Helix digital head end, which supports eCPRI-links and open fronthaul standards from the O-RAN Alliance. Complementing these are a range of Digital Distributed Antenna System (DAS) remotes: Stratus high-power digital DAS remotes deliver significant RF output (up to +43 dBm per band) across a wide frequency range (380 to 3800 MHz), supporting multiple operators and standards. Cumulus medium-power digital DAS remotes provide +30 dBm RF output per band, also for multi-operator and multi-standard use (700 to 2600 MHz). Nimbus low-power digital DAS remotes integrate seamlessly with the Helix unit via CAT6a or SFP28 connections. Maven Wireless also offers a suite of digital off-air repeaters: The Cirrus digital off-air master unit processes signals from the macro network, converting them into digital CPRI feeds. The TOR digital intrain onboard repeater is purpose-built for train coverage, embedding up to four cellular bands plus GSM-R into a single compact enclosure. Other fanless digital off-air repeaters, including the high-power Exo (two bands), medium-power Strato (three bands), and low-power Tropo (two cellular bands), all feature built-in modems. To manage its systems, Maven provides the Network Management System (NMS) with an open web API, facilitating integration with third-party Operational Support Systems (OSS) and Network Operations Centers (NOC). Maven Wireless Sweden AB (Publ) was established in 2016 and is headquartered in Kista, Sweden.
